LESSON: CHRISTIAN VALUES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to recite Psal
Topic 4.3: Christian Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Christian Values. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Christian Values
2. Practise Christian Values at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Christian Values

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Christian Values
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Christian Values. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Christian Values at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Christian Values at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Christian Values
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Christian Values. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Christian Values using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Christian Values in the examples.
2. Explain Christian Values to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Christian Values.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian Values using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Christian Values important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
